Ventix warranty policy . key rules
What you need to know before you read
Coverage window
New units are covered for 15 months from shipment or 12 months from start-up, whichever comes first. The Extended Warranty+ PlanPlano de Garantia Estendida+ extends this to five years.
Maintenance records
Every service must be logged under the unit's serial number with genuine partspeças originais. Missing records can block a claim on their own.
Certified technicians only
Any repair by someone not certified by Ventix voids the warranty on that component, even if the work was done correctly.
Oil sample requirement
When a part fails, an oil sampleamostra de óleo must be collected before the part is discarded. No sample, no automatic approval.
No unauthorized modifications
Welding, drilling, or structural changes without written approval from Ventix void the warranty on the affected section.
Ownership transfer
Coverage is tied to the end user on fileusuário final registrado. A change of owner delays claims until Ventix re-verifies.
